name: Coefficient Spaces of Partial Traces
statement: The lifted missing patterns are exactly the old patterns together with zero masks on their released support coordinates, and $\mathcal A(T_I(C))\cong\mathcal A(C)\times(0,\infty)^{r_I(C)}$. The mask-zero map is the first projection and strongly deformation retracts onto a section.
proof: Old-coordinate row ratios recover precisely a coefficient family for $C$; every new mask-to-old coefficient ratio is free. Explicit witnesses use small negative values on unreleased masks and large positive values on released masks.
